req.title: Reject duplicate playerId on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when POST /players/ is called with an ID that already exists.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-007 requires HTTP 409 Conflict when POST /players/ is called with a squad_number that already exists in the database. The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a new unique squad_number is accepted with HTTP 201, (2) a negative/EP case confirming an existing squad_number returns exactly HTTP 409, (3) a boundary/STC case confirming the transition from first-create (201) to duplicate-create (409) on the same squad_number, (4) a DT case verifying the 409 response body contains the exact conflict detail string, and (5) a BVA case using the lowest existing squad_number (1) to confirm boundary duplicate detection. All tests use FastAPI TestClient in-process, assert exact status codes, and verify response body fields to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_new_player_returns_201
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 rows (squad numbers 1-26)
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=99
expected: Response body contains the created player with squad_number=99
trace: R-PLAYER-007: positive path — unique squad_number must succeed with 201
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_new_player_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body

test_post_new_player_returns_201()

tests.name: test_post_duplicate_returns_409_not_201_or_500
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with squad number 15 (Priya Chopra)
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=15 which already exists
Assert status code is exactly 409, not 201, not 500, not 200
expected: Response body has 'detail' key with exact conflict message
trace: R-PLAYER-007: DT — decision table row: squad_number exists=true => 409; catches mutations flipping 409 to 201/500/200
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_duplicate_returns_409_not_201_or_500():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Priya",
        "lastName": "Chopra",
        "squadNumber": 15,
        "position": "Left-Back"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code != 201
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 500
    assert r.status_code == 409
    body = r.json()
    assert body["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."

test_post_duplicate_returns_409_not_201_or_500()
